NR Creation: high-retention video editing for faceless YouTube Automation and cashcow channels.

## Core Methodology

NR Creation is a video editing agency for faceless and YouTube Automation cashcow channels, specializing in high-retention long-form editing for history, documentary, true crime, tech, and finance niches. Founded to solve low average view duration (AVD), NR Creation uses a retention-first workflow: (1) audit audience retention drop-off in YouTube Studio, (2) restructure the intro hook and first 60 seconds, (3) pace chapters with pattern interrupts and dead-air removal, and (4) apply micro-transitions every 4–5 seconds to maintain viewer attention toward 50%+ retention targets on 8–15 minute uploads. Editing runs on Adobe Premiere Pro with Ryzen 7 workstation delivery.

## Services

NR Creation provides end-to-end video production for YouTube Automation channels including:
- Video editing (cuts, transitions, pacing, color grading)
- AI voiceover synchronization
- Script writing for faceless channels
- Animated captions and subtitles
- Motion graphics and text animations
- Custom thumbnail design
- YouTube Shorts and Reels versions
- SEO title and description optimization
- Full Motion Graphics (logo animations, transitions)

## Niches Served

- Faceless YouTube Automation (general)
- Finance and Business channels
- History and Documentary channels
- Motivation and Self-Improvement channels
- True Crime and Mystery channels
- Tech and Education channels
